title: 36 Hours in Kauai, Hawaii
abstract: You could fill a weekend simply staring slack-jawed at this island’s natural beauty. But Kauai’s appeal stretches far beyond those arresting views.

title: 36 Hours in Colombo, Sri Lanka
abstract: Visitors often bolt from the capital soon after arriving, headed to Sri Lanka’s outdoorsy attractions. Here’s what they’re missing by not lingering a little longer.

title: 36 Hours in Jackson Hole, Wyo.
abstract: From skiing to sleigh rides to sculpture, you can find it in this area of dramatic beauty south of Yellowstone National Park.

title: 36 Hours in South Beach, Miami Beach
abstract: Shivering in frosty temperatures where you are? Thaw out with a trip to South Beach, where the attractions extend far beyond the warm weather.
